title: fix(debug): make the spawn-timeline store additive across processes
context:
The worker records the engine marks and the dashboard records
row_in_session_list, because worker_engines.py lazily imports server, so
each process runs its own copy of this module state and the JSON file is
the only thing they share. Two bugs made the panel useless.

The file was read once at startup, so the dashboard answered every query
from a dict that predated the spawn being asked about. And a save wrote
the process's whole dict, so a freshly booted process that started one
spawn and saved
decision: Changed server.py, tests/test_spawn_timeline_store.py: added _spawn_timeline_sync, SpawnTimelineStoreTests, setUpClass, setUp, tearDown, reboot, on_disk, test_a_second_process_sees_what_the_first_one_wrote; new dep(s): importlib, json, tempfile, unittest, pathlib; 1 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: importlib, json, tempfile, unittest, pathlib.
